root_motivation: An owner searching for a pet sheltered before 2026-06-13 (or in any page the forward cursor skipped) gets zero results even when the pet is listed on RescueGroups — homeward has no record of it. Evidence: homeward-ops standing gap "RG API ~62k animals, DB ~9.7k (pre-2026-06-13 cursor not backfilled)" (verified 2026-08-31); RG v5 confirmed live with dogs+cats search endpoints 2026-09-12.
user_persona: UNSPECIFIED — no existing intent card to carry forward from; set by hand (intent-card-refresh.sh cannot source this from a PRD).

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a dev DB seeded with 100 of 500 fixture animals, When backfill runs against a fixture RG server, Then the DB holds all 500 with zero duplicate RG ids.
Given a backfill interrupted at ~50%, When the command re-runs, Then it resumes from persisted progress and the final DB matches AC1's result exactly.
Given the fixture RG server returns 429 on every third request, When backfill runs, Then it completes with all animals present and the log shows backoff events, not failures.
Given fixture animals with photos, When backfill completes, Then each has an embedding entry and the enrollment audit reads id_map.json as a list (audit count == list length for enrolled ids).
Given the fixture RG server, When backfill paginates, Then requests use page-based parameters and no request carries an `offset` param.
Given a completed run, When the report prints, Then it shows per-source fetched/inserted/skipped/failed and DB-total vs RG-total lines.
Given `--dry-run`, When invoked, Then coverage and page estimate print and the DB mtime is unchanged.
Given an empty DB, When backfill runs, Then it completes without special-casing (empty input edge).
